messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 SEV2: Prefetch telemetry spike detected — kv-cache prefetch error rate > 15% over 5m for region: us-west-2. Affected routes: /generate, /chat. Paging oncall
sara: on it — jumping in. are we seeing customer errors or just backend retries?
matt: backend retries + some 500s from runtime. seeing many fallback-to-bypass events in logs. count: ~1.8k in last 10m.
lee: quick note: prefetch writes are sometimes failing due to partial eviction mismatch. correctness safety kicks in and we do cache-bypass; that's expensive.
nina: product — any customer-facing errors reported yet? support?
dev-support: one support ticket from AcmeCorp, they see elevated latencies and a few aborted streams. queued message to CSM.
carlos: telemetry: rolling window shows p95 latency for /generate up from 220ms -> 980ms for affected hosts. token cost up too.
sara: immediate mitigations idea list: 1) disable prefetch for high-cardinality prefixes 2) tighten per-tenant prefetch quotas 3) temporarily route high-QPS tenants to safe-model variant 4) apply rate cap on prefetch writes. which is low-risk?
matt: lowest blast radius is disabling prefetch (write path) for affected shard set + apply rate cap. we can flip a flag per-shard via deploy config.
lee: config snippet to disable prefetch on runtime nodes:
```
service.prefetch.enabled = false
service.prefetch.scope = "shard:us-west-2-a"
```
I'll push a hotpatch if SRE approves.
sara: matt — can you set an emergency quota carve for tenants with >500 qps? reduce prefetch windows to 1s->10s?
matt: applying per-tenant prefetch quota: `prefetch_quota=250` for tenants over threshold. will roll to edge nodes in ~90s.
carlos: adding a filter to observability to track which tenants were served from bypass vs cache hit — pushing dashboard now.
dev-support: CSM pinged AcmeCorp with note: "we're investigating higher latency; may apply temporary mitigations that don't affect correctness."
lee: deployed prefetch flag to shard us-west-2-a (commit 9d3f1e). logs show prefetch writes stop for that shard.
matt: quota carveout applied. rate cap enforced via edge-proxy: `limit: prefetch 300/s per-tenant`
sara: rolling impact check — any drop in bypass events?
carlos: bypass events decreased by 68% on the patched shard, overall cluster down 45%. latency p95 improving to ~420ms.
nina: product: prepare a short customer note — impacted customers may see slightly higher inference latency but correctness preserved. avoid promising ETA yet.
dev-support: update: AcmeCorp acknowledged, asked whether tokens/cost will spike — we're capturing token delta.
sara: next steps: 1) monitor for 30m, 2) if stable, re-enable prefetch with reduced concurrency, 3) plan root cause (eviction mismatch) postmortem. who owns RCA?
lee: runtime-eng will own RCA with SRE. I'll start a log dump: `logs query "prefetch write fail" since -60m`
matt: I'll stay on-monitor for 60m and coordinate rollback window. if we see <1% error and p95 <300ms, we'll consider gradual re-enable.
carlos: dashboard link: https://obs.redwood/s/alerts/2470001234 (internal)
incident-bot: pagerduty: incident acknowledged by sara.
sara: handing off to matt for night watch. matt — you ok taking oncall for remainder?
matt: taking it. ping me if anything regresses.
nina: scheduling customer comms sync at +45m to decide messaging.
dev-support: adding post-incident tag and collecting affected tenant list.
sara: thanks team. I'll update incident timeline and add initial severity + mitigation notes.
matt: observed small regression at +15m (one host restarted), killed prefetch process on that host, backhealthy now.
carlos: final check at +276s: bypass events stable, p95 trending down. marking mitigation as successful for now.
